samples.question: The image shows a REFERENCE panel and candidate panels A and B. Each panel contains six uniquely colored dots. Exactly three dot centers in each panel lie on one shared straight line, and no other triple is collinear. Which candidate has the same set of three colors on the line as the REFERENCE? Panels may be translated, rotated, or reflected; ignore panel position, dot position, dot size, and drawing order. A is the left candidate and B is the right candidate. Answer A or B.
